## Challenge pass disposition

The three independent filters completed factual accuracy, taxonomy and duplication, plus prose and audience review. No evidence-backed correction was rejected.

* C01 revised. Add an audience matrix, lifecycle, canonical source rule, immutable-history correction procedure, and pointer discipline.
* C02 revised. Separate remediation from deterministic checks. Cover maintained authored prose and future records. Treat scan counts as triage only.
* C03 revised. Expand format coverage and remove citation-only exemption. Keep subjective comment necessity in policy and manual review.
* C04 retained. Preserve the tested quickstart and reduce README.md to client onboarding.
* C05 revised. Provide one landing page with labeled client and developer routes. Classify historical artifacts before relocation.
* C06 revised. Correct confirmed signing surfaces, remove docs/llm-framework.md from the defect list, classify each HMAC use, and distinguish client use from internal mechanism.
* C07 revised. Keep the confirmed import correction and express timing, partial results, reruns, and recovery in user-visible terms.
* C08 revised. Correct accepted option omissions separately from the RP-05 command discovery dependency.
* C09 revised. Split multiline MCP summary generation from server manifest description validation. Change generated output through canonical sources.
* C10 revised. Split client templates, demonstration assets, and example skill workflow guidance. Establish demonstration ownership before editing.
* C11 revised. Keep task-focused client workflows and remove internal implementation narration.
* C12 revised. Make the generated configuration reference the external settings contract. Keep extension invariants in internal documentation and correct ADR links.
* C13 revised. Keep the confirmed GITHUB_ENV correction. Replace the inaccurate omission claim with canonical verify-identity and exact exempt type guidance.
* C14 merged into C15. Preserve required JIRA_PROJECT selection, validation, and unsupported fallback removal.
* C15 revised. Split the external Jira operator checklist from repairs or retirement of internal onboarding and pressure tools.
* C16 retained. Keep the packaged plan guide task focused and move reviewer design to internal reference material.
* C17 revised. Split support, private security reporting, conduct escalation, issue forms, and mirror prerequisites. Preserve the existing Nava PBC backstop and clarify its mechanism.
* C18 revised. Make CONTRIBUTING.md canonical. Reduce AGENTS.md and other entry points to audience-specific constraints and pointers. Include pull request and Copilot instruction files.
* C19 retained. Present one validation and recovery sequence for connector-limited clients.
* C20 revised. Split architecture, event contract, concurrency, and migration registry documents. Derive current types and events from source.
* C21 revised. Correct ADR 0090 relationships, add minimal lifecycle metadata, preserve historical decision text, and add errata or annotations.
* C22 revised. Classify each completed plan, evidence file, design note, migration record, and runbook separately. Preserve frozen evidence and append corrections to tickets.
* C23 revised. Separate current exit-code reference from release communication. Preserve user-visible change history and move implementation chronology to tickets.
* C24 retained. Add the five confirmed public mutation docstrings and align the reuse surface.
* C25 retained. Correct the confirmed Jira backend narration as a bounded developer-facing accuracy task.
* C26 revised. Use an exact file and symbol inventory for production, script, operational, and test comments. Absorb the applicable parts of C29, C30, and C32.
* C27 revised. Split internal prompts and evaluations from client-visible schema descriptions. Preserve executable contracts and wording fixtures.
* C28 revised. Limit work to confirmed diagnostics, logs, workflow annotations, and presentation strings. State cause and next action while preserving stable tokens.
* C29 merged. Move embedded comments to C26, historical runbook material to C22, and inaccurate operator procedures to C33.
* C30 merged into C26. Preserve test-specific rules for failure oracles, unusual fixtures, regression references, and wording fixtures.
* C31 revised. Inventory each procedure and corpus before classification. Keep procedure, evidence, conclusion, and decision roles distinct.
* C32 merged into C03 and C26. Keep the manual-review condition and do not treat separator counts as defects.
* C33 revised and split. Create separate MCP authentication, S3 operations, and Gerrit operations tasks. Move mirror support conflict to C17. Remove an unsupported S3 accuracy claim unless further evidence establishes one.
* C34 revised and split. Separate package license provenance, Jira Data Center fixture provenance, and example skill metadata. Research uncertain provenance before prescribing notices.

Required additions include the ordinary-ticket completion gate correction in README.md, the absolute module-size policy correction in docs/maintenance-audit-runbook.md, broader scope and current-state narration for scripts/check_docs_index.py, generated-source ownership for configuration, ADR, CLI, MCP, synchronized template, and demonstration artifacts, plus coverage for issue forms, pull request templates, Copilot instructions, package descriptions, project URLs, server manifest descriptions, Makefile help, Dockerfile comments, workflow annotations, spoken narration, and YAML, TOML, HCL, and shell help text.

Historical ticket events and commit messages remain unchanged. Corrections use append-only comments or linked notices. Licenses, quotations, captured evidence, wording fixtures, code syntax, and derived output remain protected.
